---
title: "About me"
---

I am a Research Fellow in Statistics at the Department of Economics, Management and Statistics, University of Milano-Bicocca.

I received my PhD in Statistics from the University of Milano-Bicocca in February 2025. My doctoral thesis, *Advances in Bayesian Methods: Nonparametric Network Modeling and Scalable Computations*, focused on Bayesian nonparametric methods for network data and scalable Bayesian computation.

My research interests include Bayesian statistics, Bayesian nonparametrics, statistical network analysis, computational statistics, and Bayesian modeling of complex data.

## Teaching

I have taught and assisted courses in statistics at the master's level, including *Inferential Statistics* and *Advanced Statistics*, with a particular focus on applications in economics and management.

## Academic service

I have served as a referee for journals including *Computational Statistics & Data Analysis* and the *IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics*.
